name: Nadi Produce Market
bio_draft: Market: daily fresh produce market on Hospital Road, Nadi, open Monday to Saturday.

name: Nausori Highlands
bio_draft: Highlands: dry-zone mountain rainforest behind Nadi offering nature walks, hikes and off-road tours.

name: Lautoka Market
bio_draft: Market: large covered produce, spice and kava market beside the Lautoka bus station.

name: Monuriki
bio_draft: Uninhabited island: the Cast Away filming island (2000 film), with white beaches and a pine forest; Wikivoyage calls it very much off the beaten track.

name: Mana Island
bio_draft: Island resort: three beach areas, lagoon snorkelling and water sports; a Survivor filming location.

name: Beachcomber Island
bio_draft: Island resort: a private island with a backpacker resort, snorkelling, dive shop and the nightly Bula Dance; reached from Denarau by catamaran.
